home.subtitle: ApplyFlowo automates job applications, autofills forms, and tracks your progress — so you focus on landing your dream job.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to land your dream job
home.featuresSubtitle: From autofilling forms to tracking interviews, ApplyFlowo handles it all.
home.featureAutoApplyDesc: Save hours of manual work. Apply to jobs with a single click.
home.featureSmartAutofillDesc: Fill job forms instantly with your saved profile data.
home.featureTrackProgressDesc: Kanban board: Applied, Interview, Accepted — all visual.
home.featureCvAssistantDesc: Upload once, reuse everywhere. Your CV always ready.
home.step01Desc: Add ApplyFlowo to Chrome in one click. Setup takes 30 seconds.
home.step02Desc: Visit any job site and click Auto Fill. We handle the rest.
home.step03Desc: View all applications on your Kanban dashboard. Stay organized.
home.review1Text: Saved me 10+ hours per week on applications. The autofill is incredible — I just click and everything is filled perfectly.
home.review2Text: Best job automation tool I've ever used. The Kanban board keeps me so organized. Got 3 offers in one month!
home.review3Text: The CV assistant is a game changer. Upload once and it works everywhere. Landed my dream job in 2 weeks.
home.faq1A: Yes! The Chrome extension and basic features are completely free. We offer premium plans for power users who need advanced tracking and analytics.
home.faq2A: ApplyFlowo works with 50+ job sites including LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, AngelList, and many more. We add new sites every week.
home.faq3A: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted end-to-end. We never sell your data or share it with third parties. Your privacy is our top priority.
home.faq4Q: Can I use it on multiple devices?
home.faq4A: Yes! Your account syncs across all devices. Install the extension on any Chrome browser and your data will be there.
home.faq5A: ApplyFlow is currently in active development. Core features are working, and your feedback helps us improve faster.
home.ctaFinalSubtitle: Join thousands of job seekers who save hours every week with ApplyFlowo.
home.ctaFinalNote: No credit card required. Free forever for basic use.

extension.step1Desc: Click the download button to get the extension files.
extension.step2Desc: Unzip the downloaded file to a folder on your computer.
extension.step3Desc: Navigate to chrome://extensions in your Chrome browser.
extension.step4Desc: Toggle the "Developer mode" switch in the top right corner.
extension.step5Desc: Click the "Load unpacked" button that appears.
extension.step6Desc: Navigate to and select the extracted extension folder.
extension.trouble1Desc: Make sure Developer Mode is enabled and you selected the correct folder. Try reloading the extensions page.
extension.trouble2Desc: Log out and log back into the extension using your dashboard credentials. Clear browser cache if needed.
extension.trouble3Desc: Some job sites block file uploads. Try using the autofill feature or upload your CV through the dashboard.
